args.summary:
Built and analysed a 2D spine-beam model of a three-span (35+45+35 m) cast-in-place continuous prestressed box-girder bridge on a 12.5 m deck.

Modeling decisions (all with code/rule provenance):
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d (MR-01); system: continuous_on_piers (MR-05), since twin pier columns are modelled.
- Girder: single-cell cast box, integrated section A = 6.712 m², I = 4.4982 m⁴ (MR-02); Ec = 37000 MPa per material tests (MR-00 overrides JTG3362 table); γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTGD60-4.2.1); w = 174.512 kN/m, m = 17.789 t/m (MR-07).
- Piers: twin D=1.8 m circular columns merged, A = 5.0894 m², I = 2.0615 m⁴ (MR-06), C40 Ec = 32500 MPa; lengths 20 m (Pier 1) and 27 m (Pier 2).
- Bearings (zero-length springs, MR-03/MR-04): Abutments 0 & 3 and Pier 2 are PTFE sliding (Kh=0), two per line; Pier 1 is plain fixed (Kh=10,909 kN/m). Kv from JTG3362-8.7: 3,141,567 (abutments), 8,029,056 (Pier 1), 7,175,027 kN/m (Pier 2). All rotation free, vertical spring.
- Live load (Class I, 3 lanes): n_lanes=3, ξ=0.78, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=330/350/330 kN per span; impact factor μ = 0.1808 from f1 = 3.037 Hz (JTG D60-4.3.2).

Results: first vertical bending frequency 3.037 Hz; self-weight support reactions ≈ 2241/7780/7779/2249 kN; self-weight midspan moments ≈ 12493/15853/12632 kNm; lane-load max positive moment 11476 kNm (span 2) and max negative moment −9094 kNm at support 1. All L1–L3 checks passed.
